title: Add admin-only daily updates for marks, test subjects, and attendance

requirements.text: Implement admin role verification in the backend to restrict mark updates, test subject management, and attendance updates to users with admin privileges only

quotes: marks and And test subject and attendance to be updated by admin everyday

acceptanceCriteria: Backend methods for updating marks, managing test subjects, and updating attendance verify caller has admin role
Non-admin users receive appropriate error messages when attempting restricted operations
Admin role check uses existing role-based access control from user profiles

requirements.text: Create backend functionality to manage test subjects including adding new subjects, editing subject names, and retrieving all available subjects
acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores test subjects with unique identifiers and names
Admin users can add new test subjects
Admin users can edit existing test subject names
All users can retrieve the list of available test subjects
Test subjects persist across canister upgrades

requirements.text: Enhance the marks recording interface to support daily updates by admin users, allowing selection from managed test subjects and updating existing mark entries

quotes: marks and And test subject and attendance to be updated by admin everyday

acceptanceCriteria: Admin users see a dropdown to select from available test subjects when recording marks
Admin users can update existing mark entries for a student-subject-exam combination
The interface displays the current date by default for daily updates
Non-admin users cannot access mark update functionality
Success and error messages provide clear feedback for mark operations

requirements.text: Create an admin interface for test subject management allowing admins to add new subjects and edit existing subject names
acceptanceCriteria: Admin users can access a test subjects management section
Interface displays a list of all existing test subjects
Admin users can add new test subjects with validation
Admin users can edit existing test subject names
Non-admin users cannot access this interface
Changes reflect immediately in the marks recording dropdown

requirements.text: Enhance the attendance interface to support daily updates by admin users, allowing them to mark or update attendance for multiple students efficiently

quotes: attendance to be updated by admin everyday

acceptanceCriteria: Admin users can mark attendance for the current date
Admin users can update previously recorded attendance entries
The interface defaults to today's date for daily attendance marking
Non-admin users cannot access attendance update functionality
Attendance updates provide immediate visual feedback and confirmation

requirements.text: Implement role-based UI rendering that shows or hides admin-only features (marks updates, test subject management, attendance updates) based on the authenticated user's role from their profile

quotes: to be updated by admin everyday

acceptanceCriteria: Admin users see all management features including update capabilities
Non-admin users (Teacher, Staff) see read-only views without update controls
Role checks use the user profile role field already stored in the backend
Navigation and page layouts adapt based on user role
Unauthorized access attempts to admin routes redirect to appropriate pages

constraints: Use existing role-based access control from user profiles (Administrator, Teacher, Staff roles)
Preserve existing student records, marks, and attendance data structures
Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or other immutable paths
nonGoals: Multi-day or bulk attendance marking interfaces
Email or notification systems for attendance/marks updates
Grade calculation or GPA computation features
